resolutions.rationale: The live burden requires defended links from logical truths to a necessary mind and its identification with God. The explicitly provisional opening contains the undeveloped mental-character and identification links, while the translation and knowledge moves separately carry the contested inference from shared or known content to real proposition entities. Option-a more completely locates these distinct completion issues in their existing moves; no additional independent consequence is established.

The critical burden is to expose an unmet bridge in the offered logic-to-God route, not to disprove every god. Distinguishing necessary reality from contingent descriptions directly addresses that burden, alongside the constructed-label account of knowledge and the claim that concrete instances make separate propositions dispensable. Option-a includes that central necessity distinction as well as the later explanatory gaps, locating both strengths and limitations in existing moves without inventing a further debate-wide consequence.
